data.case_title: Health insurance contribution notice – Allgemeine Musterkasse
data.title: Contribution notice for voluntary health insurance membership from 1 June 2026
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse (statutory health insurer) informs Mara Beispiel that, based on submitted income evidence, her voluntary membership contributions from 1 June 2026 are set at €412.65 for health insurance and €118.20 for long-term care insurance, totalling €530.85 per month, collected by direct debit on the 15th of the following month.
data.explanation: This is your health insurer's official decision (Bescheid) fixing your monthly contribution as a voluntarily insured member at €530.85, starting 1 June 2026. The amount will be taken from your account automatically each month. If you think the calculation is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) against this notice — the app shows until when. No other action is needed if you agree with the amount; otherwise contact the insurer or consider getting advice before the deadline shown.
